newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Dec cash retail sales rise 0.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Dec cash retail sales rise 0.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch retail sales rose 0.2 percent in cash terms in December 1996 compared with December 1995, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
In volume terms December 1996 retail sales were 0.5 percent lower than in December 1995, the CBS added.
DUTCH RETAIL SALES Dec 96 Nov 96 Dec 95

NOTES - The CBS noted that December 1996 had one Friday and one Saturday less and one Monday and one Tuesday more than December 1995. November 1996 had one Wednesday and one Thursday less and one Friday and one Saturday more than November 1995.
The fourth quarter of 1996 had one Sunday less and one Tuesday more than the same period of 1995.
